newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: GOLF-ROCCA LOOKING FOR A RETURN TO FORM IN DUTCH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-ROCCA LOOKING FOR A RETURN TO FORM IN DUTCH OPEN.

text.p: Constantino Rocca will be looking for a return to form in the Dutch Open to ignite his challenge for a third successive appearance in Europe's Ryder Cup team.
The Italian currently holds ninth spot in the Ryder Cup table, having slipped back from third place at the start of the season.
He will eye the 116,660 pounds ($195,000) first prize -- a sum which would virtually guarantee his ticket for Valderrama.
However, Rocca is still struggling with his game after back and shoulder injuries and missed the cut in the British Open last week by three strokes.

Rocca is the only one of Europe's Ryder Cup table top 10 in the Hilversum field, providing a golden chance for several Valderrama aspirants just out of the automatic placings to stake their claims for Severiano Ballesteros's team.
Englishman Mark James (15th) boosted his hopes of an eighth Ryder Cup appearance when he finished 20th at Royal Troon.

Scotland's Sam Torrance (13th) and Spaniard Iganacio Garrido (14th) failed to make the cut at the British Open and will be looking for some form in the Dutch event beginning on Thursday to strike while the players above them are absent.
Defending champion Mark McNulty will take heart from a 32nd place in the British Open in an injury-hit season which sees him languish 63rd in Europe's order of merit.
The only high-flier at Royal Troon to feature in Hilversum is Trinidadian Stephen Ames. He finished joint fifth in the British Open.
